headline: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) Wins EU Deal Clearance As Its AI Plans Take Shape
summary: European Commission clears Paramount Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on competition grounds, marking a key regulatory step in Europe. Approval follows earlier international reviews and sits alongside ongoing legal challenges in the US as of late July 2026. Warner Bros. Discovery, ticker NasdaqGS:WBD, also outlines plans to expand its use of generative AI with a focus on growth and creator support.
